products.body:
For the first time ever, Gordon Ryan is going to share his take on the standing position and takedowns, this instructional is structured like never before with an emphasis on high level concepts that are broadly applicable and usable

  • As opposed to specific techniques Gordon is going to change your perspective on standing by showing the concepts he has used to dominate the competition at the highest level of the sport.
  • Gordon is the greatest no gi grappler in the history of the sport and he is the most dominant. He has implemented his standing technique's throughout the entirety of his career against the greatest of the great
  • His ADCC titles have come from his incredible ability to defend himself in the standing position. In this series you can see inside his mind and learn the same defensive concepts he uses to simplify the standing position. 
  • This series is ideal for anyone at any level with an emphasis on beginners concepts. Gordon's "beginner" concepts can still change the perspective and game of black belts.



Check Out a Free Sample:

What Will You Learn? 

For the first time ever, Gordon Ryan is going to share his take on the standing position and takedowns, this instructional is structured like never before with an emphasis on high level concepts that are broadly applicable and usable. This series focuses on helping ANYONE develop confidence in their stand up.

As opposed to specific techniques Gordon is going to change your perspective on standing by showing the concepts he has used to dominate the competition at the highest level of the sport.  

Gordon is the greatest no gi grappler in the history of the sport and he is the most dominant. He has implemented his standing technique's throughout the entirety of his career against the greatest of the great. His ADCC titles have come from his incredible ability to defend himself in the standing position. In this series you can see inside his mind and learn the same defensive concepts he uses to simplify the standing position. 

There is a reason Gordon is who he is, if you have never seen a Gordon Ryan instructional now is the time, Gordon is one of the most talented instructors on the planet. Competition resume aside (and his is the best in the world) he is able to articulate information on another level.

Who Is This For?

This series is ideal for anyone at any level with an emphasis on beginners concepts. Gordon's "beginner" concepts can still change the perspective and game of black belts.

products.body:
Gordon Ryan—widely recognized as the greatest no-gi grappler of all time—unleashes his deep technical mastery in Systematically Attacking the Scrimmage: Lower Body Takedowns.

  • Under the legendary guidance of coach John Danaher, Gordon has evolved into one of grappling’s most brilliant tacticians, and now he’s turning his analytical focus toward a notoriously underdeveloped area in no-gi: the art of lower body takedowns.
  • In this groundbreaking instructional, Gordon meticulously breaks down ankle pick variations, single legs, knee taps, and far more.
  • Designed for practitioners of all levels, this series provides a complete system—not just isolated techniques—making it the most comprehensive lower body takedown resource ever released in the sport of submission grappling.
  • Whether you’re competing in ADCC, preparing for superfights, or sharpening your ability to dictate the pace of a match, Gordon equips you with the tools to consistently off-balance, penetrate, and finish from the feet.

What will You Learn?

Gordon Ryan—widely recognized as the greatest no-gi grappler of all time—unleashes his deep technical mastery in Systematically Attacking the Scrimmage: Lower Body Takedowns. Under the legendary guidance of coach John Danaher, Gordon has evolved into one of grappling’s most brilliant tacticians and minds, and now he’s turning his analytical focus toward a notoriously underdeveloped area in no-gi: the art of lower body takedowns.

In this groundbreaking instructional, Gordon meticulously breaks down ankle pick variations, single legs, knee taps, and far more. Designed for practitioners of all levels, this series provides a complete system—not just isolated techniques—making it the most comprehensive lower body takedown resource ever released in the sport of submission grappling.

Whether you’re competing in ADCC, preparing for superfights, or sharpening your ability to dictate the pace of a match, Gordon equips you with the tools to consistently off-balance, penetrate, and finish from the feet.

What You’ll Learn:

  • ✅ The most complete breakdown of ankle pick variations ever filmed

  • ✅ How to control and win the “scrimmage” phase where most takedowns are lost

  • ✅ Strategies to blend seamlessly between wrestling and guard pulls for maximum tactical advantage

  • ✅ Real-world applications from the ADCC champion himself, with unmatched clarity and detail

No fluff. No outdated techniques. Just proven, cutting-edge tactics from the most dominant force in modern grappling. If you're serious about elevating your takedown game, Systematically Attacking the Scrimmage: Lower Body Takedowns is the new gold standard.

products.title: Systematically Attacking The Scrimmage: Submission Offense by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
Widely regarded as the greatest No-Gi grappler of all time, Gordon has built his career on systematically dismantling the world's best athletes through superior positional understanding and relentless submission offense

  • In the latest installment of his acclaimed Systematically Attacking the Scrimmage series, Gordon reveals how to transform transitional exchanges into one of the most dangerous parts of your game.
  • It's a complete offensive framework for identifying opportunities in the scrimmage, creating dilemmas your opponent can't solve, and flowing seamlessly from one attack to the next until the finish is inevitable
  • Whether you're attacking guillotines, front headlocks, arm locks, triangles, leg locks, or back takes, Gordon explains the concepts that connect every submission together. Rather than relying on speed or athleticism, you'll learn how to use positioning, leverage, timing, and intelligent decision-making to stay several moves ahead of your opponent
  • What makes Gordon's instruction so valuable is his ability to simplify incredibly complex situations. He breaks every exchange into a logical system, showing not only what to do, but why each decision creates the next opportunity. The result is a submission game that feels fluid, calculated, and impossible to stop.



What will You Learn?

The scrimmage is where matches are won.

It's the chaotic space between established positions—where elite grapplers create openings, force reactions, and find submissions long before their opponents realize they're in danger.

No one understands this better than Gordon Ryan.

Widely regarded as the greatest No-Gi grappler of all time, Gordon has built his career on systematically dismantling the world's best athletes through superior positional understanding and relentless submission offense. In the latest installment of his acclaimed Systematically Attacking the Scrimmage series, Gordon reveals how to transform transitional exchanges into one of the most dangerous parts of your game.

This isn't a collection of submissions.

It's a complete offensive framework for identifying opportunities in the scrimmage, creating dilemmas your opponent can't solve, and flowing seamlessly from one attack to the next until the finish is inevitable.

Whether you're attacking guillotines, front headlocks, arm locks, triangles, leg locks, or back takes, Gordon explains the concepts that connect every submission together. Rather than relying on speed or athleticism, you'll learn how to use positioning, leverage, timing, and intelligent decision-making to stay several moves ahead of your opponent.

What makes Gordon's instruction so valuable is his ability to simplify incredibly complex situations. He breaks every exchange into a logical system, showing not only what to do, but why each decision creates the next opportunity. The result is a submission game that feels fluid, calculated, and impossible to stop.

If you've ever found yourself winning the positional battle but struggling to finish... or if you've watched Gordon effortlessly transition from scramble to submission against the world's best competitors and wondered how he makes it look so easy, this instructional provides the blueprint.

Stop reacting to scrambles.

Start attacking them.

Master the most dynamic phase of grappling and turn every transitional exchange into a submission opportunity with one of the greatest minds the sport has ever seen.

What You'll Learn

  • Build a systematic submission game from transitional scrimmage positions
  • Learn how Gordon identifies and creates submission opportunities before they disappear
  • Connect front headlocks, guillotines, arm locks, triangles, leg locks, and back attacks into one cohesive system
  • Create dilemmas that force predictable reactions and lead directly to submissions
  • Master the concepts of timing, leverage, and positional control that make elite submission hunters so dangerous
  • Learn to attack during transitions instead of waiting for fully established positions
  • Develop the decision-making skills to stay one step ahead in every scramble
  • Turn winning positions into reliable finishes against resisting opponents

Features & Benefits

  • Learn directly from Gordon Ryan, the greatest No-Gi grappler of his generation
  • Continue the acclaimed Systematically Attacking the Scrimmage instructional series
  • Study the submission systems Gordon has used against the highest level of competition
  • Transform chaotic scrambles into organized offensive opportunities
  • Understand the concepts—not just the techniques—that make submissions inevitable
  • Perfect for competitors and hobbyists looking to dramatically increase their finishing rate

The Bottom Line

The world's best grapplers don't wait for perfect positions—they create submission opportunities in the moments between them.

With Systematically Attacking the Scrimmage: Submission Offense, Gordon Ryan shows you exactly how to do the same.

products.title: Systematically Attacking The Scrimmage: Upper Body Takedowns by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
Gordon Ryan is back to address one of the most crucial—and often overlooked—aspects of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu: takedowns

  • In this deeply comprehensive 8-volume series, Gordon dives deep into upper-body takedowns. This course explores a wide array of high-percentage, underutilized techniques from the standing position, making it an invaluable resource for BJJ practitioners of all levels.
  • In this series, Gordon breaks down dozens of the most effective and important upper-body takedowns, going beyond just the mechanics. True to his teaching style, Gordon doesn't just show you how to perform these techniques—he also teaches the essential connections and concepts that allow for immediate implementation.
  • Widely regarded as the greatest no-gi competitor of all time, Gordon Ryan has earned his reputation as the undisputed GOAT of BJJ. His techniques work effortlessly at the highest levels of competition, and his approach combines simplicity with fundamentals—allowing him to outclass opponents with ease
  • Upper-body takedowns are a cornerstone of the standing game in BJJ. When mastered, they open up a world of opportunities—from guillotines and upper-body joint locks to, of course, positional dominance.



Check Out a Free Sample:

What Will You Learn?

Gordon Ryan Returns to Tackle One of BJJ's Most Critical Aspects: Takedowns

Gordon Ryan is back to address one of the most crucial—and often overlooked—aspects of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu: takedowns. In this deeply comprehensive 8-volume series, Gordon dives deep into upper-body takedowns. This course explores a wide array of high-percentage, underutilized techniques from the standing position, making it an invaluable resource for BJJ practitioners of all levels.

In this series, Gordon breaks down dozens of the most effective and important upper-body takedowns, going beyond just the mechanics. True to his teaching style, Gordon doesn't just show you how to perform these techniques—he also teaches the essential connections and concepts that allow for immediate implementation. You’ll learn how to seamlessly flow into dominant positions and submissions, setting the foundation for victory in every match.

Why Gordon Ryan?

Widely regarded as the greatest no-gi competitor of all time, Gordon Ryan has earned his reputation as the undisputed GOAT of BJJ. His techniques work effortlessly at the highest levels of competition, and his approach combines simplicity with fundamentals—allowing him to outclass opponents with ease. Under the guidance of the legendary John Danaher, Gordon has developed a unique perspective on BJJ, which is evident in every one of his instructional courses.

Unlock the Secrets to Dominance

Upper-body takedowns are a cornerstone of the standing game in BJJ. When mastered, they open up a world of opportunities—from guillotines and upper-body joint locks to, of course, positional dominance. See why countless BJJ practitioners trust Gordon Ryan to lead their learning and take their skills to the next level.
